root_cause.text: Calling free_irq() while holding the mcp_lock mutex in the error path of mcp251x_open() creates a deadlock because the interrupt handler also acquires that mutex, leading to a circular wait when free_irq() waits for the handler to finish.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explicitly states: "the mcp251x_open() function call free_irq() in its error path with the mpc_lock mutex held. But if an interrupt already occurred the interrupt handler will be waiting for the mpc_lock and free_irq() will deadlock waiting for the handler to finish." The fix moves free_irq() after mutex_unlock and sets priv->force_quit = 1 beforehand to allow the interrupt handler to exit quickly once it acquires the lock.
